Academic professional with over 19 years of experience in teaching, research, and university-level administration. Actively involved in quality assurance, ERP-enabled academic governance, examination systems, research coordination, and student welfare administration.

NAAC & Accreditation Activities:
Served as a core team member for SSR preparation during DAVV’s NAAC accreditation process, contributing to data compilation, documentation, and institutional reporting.
Medical College Establishment (DAVV):
Actively involved in preparing proposals, project reports, and statutory applications for the establishment of a new Medical College of DAVV at Jhabua (M.P.) in 2026-27.
ERP & Automation Initiatives:
Serving as a key contributor in ERP implementation and academic automation projects at DAVV.
AICTE Compliance & Regulatory Coordination:
Coordinated AICTE-related academic and administrative matters at IET-DAVV since 2006, including compilation and submission of annual compliance and approval reports.
Programme Expansion & Funding Proposals:
Successfully prepared and submitted:

AICTE proposals for enhancement of BTech programme intake, Introduction to New BTech, MBA and BDes Programs at IET and Proposals to DEB-UGC for introduction of new MBA and MCA (ODL and Online) programs at CDOE, DAVV.
TEQIP Phase-II World Bank grant proposal to SPFU, Directorate of Technical Education, Madhya Pradesh.
Academic & Examination Data Analytics:
Applied analytical tools for preparation of educational statistics, examination analysis, and institutional performance reports.
University Administration Support:
Assisted administrative offices in admission process, student database management, result processing, and academic record handling, alongside regular teaching responsibilities.
Hostel & Student Welfare Administration:
As Warden / Assistant Warden, prepared annual reports on hostel admissions, fee collections, internal quality assessment, and feedback analysis on hostel and mess facilities.
Examination & Valuation Systems:
As OSD at Valuation Centre (DAVV), prepared confidential result statistics, fail–pass analysis, remuneration charts, valuation/revaluation reports, and review analyses across programmes.
Administrative Support in Reporting:
Assisted university administration in drafting statutory and academic reports and official submissions to the Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh.
Student Mentoring & Counselling:
Actively engaged as a student mentor at IET-DAVV, providing academic and personal counselling and preparing structured reports on student issues and interventions.
Placement & Career Support Activities:
Supported placement activities through student data management, eligibility screening, placement statistics, recruiter coordination, and report preparation.
University Events & Youth Festivals:
Coordinated annual University Youth Festivals from UTD to national level as a committee member, managing accommodation, catering, and event planning etc.
Academic Outreach & Capacity Building:

Prepared proposals for and successfully organized national- and state-level academic and capacity-building workshops, including coordination for state-wide ERP implementation programmes; also actively involved in organizing academic and student development activities, including academic tours and industrial visits.
